Schema conflates account-wide ownership (owned_auras, owned_frames) with server-bound equipped state (active_aura, active_frame). Canonical policy requires structural split: ownership=account_wide, bonus_activation=server_bound. Cannot be encoded as a single ensure_server_scope blanket call without changing semantics. Also writes to db.users (explicitly skipped collection) and db.territory_control (separate guild-level semantics).

File aggregates 5 distinct subsystems with conflicting account/server semantics: (1) paid currency (gems) is account_wide but free currency (gold) is server_bound; (2) battle_pass season is account-level but rewards distribute to server-bound currencies; (3) vip_data is mixed (vip_level=account_wide, vip_claim_state=server_bound); (4) mail can be account or server origin; (5) contains legacy /server/select endpoint at line 195-206 which is FORBIDDEN scope (server selection runtime endpoints). Patching any single write risks activating server selection runtime semantics or rewriting balance/economy logic, both explicitly forbidden.
